title: The weMail WordPress plugin through 2.1.6 does not restrict a site-wide third-party email-service API key to…
description: The weMail WordPress plugin versions through 2.1.6 expose a site-wide third-party email-service API key to users with the Editor role by displaying it on an admin screen accessible to them. This exposure allows Editors to obtain a reusable credential that can be used without a WordPress session to impersonate other users and disrupt the site's email-service connection.
